queries_run: AbbVie China tariff OR trade restriction 2026

findings.claim: AbbVie 10-K 風險因子列出貿易限制／關稅可能提高成本、中斷供應鏈，為已揭露風險。
findings.excerpt: Trade restrictions, tariffs, and other changes in global trade policy could increase costs, disrupt supply chains, and adversely affect AbbVie’s business and results of operations.

findings.claim: 2026年1月AbbVie與美國政府達成自願協議，承諾10年內1000億美元美國研發與資本投資，換取三年關稅與未來價格強制令豁免。
findings.excerpt: AbbVie pledged $100 billion in U.S.-based research and development and capital investments, including manufacturing, over the next decade. Under this voluntary agreement, the U.S. government has agreed to provide AbbVie a three-year exemption from tariffs and future price mandates.

findings.claim: Global Trade Alert 記載美國與AbbVie關於MFN藥價與關稅豁免協議。
findings.excerpt: United States of America: Agreement with AbbVie on Most-Favoured-Nation drug pricing and tariff exemption Announcement 12 Jan 2026

reg_tariff_export.note: 搜尋未見中國特定關稅或出口管制對ABBV的2026事件；2026-04-02 Section 232 藥品關稅公告中ABBV具體待遇搜尋摘要未確認。 線索 1 條，程式核實 1 條
